    AI Overview
    Cameron and Cayden Boozer are elite twin basketball players, currently starring for the Duke Blue Devils. Sons of former NBA All-Star Carlos Boozer, the 2025 recruits are known for their high-level play, championship pedigree, and a unique birth story as they were conceived to be genetic matches to help save their older brother's life. 
    This video discusses the brothers' close bond and shared love for the game:
    58s
    Duke Basketball
    YouTube• Mar 27, 2026
    Key Details about the Boozer Brothers: 
    • Background: Born on July 18, 2007, they are the sons of Carlos Boozer and CeCe Boozer.
    • Family & Health: The twins were born through IVF to serve as bone marrow donors for their older brother, Carmani, who was battling sickle cell disease, effectively curing him, according to heavy.com and Instagram.
    • Basketball Careers: As 5-star recruits in the class of 2025, they committed to Duke University, where they have been leading scorers and top performers in the NCAA Tournament.
    • Playing Style: Cameron is a versatile forward, and Cayden is a skilled point guard. Both are noted for their high basketball IQ and winning mindset.
    • NIL & Partnerships: They have partnered with brands like Zaxbys and Leaf trading cards. 
    Career Highlights: 
    • They gained national attention for their performance in the 2026 March Madness tournament, where they helped lead Duke to the Elite Eight, notes Ball Durham.
    • They have been praised by opposing coaches, such as UConn's Dan Hurley, for their toughness and approach to the game, notes On3. 
    Note: There is also a separate entity, "Booze Brothers Philly," which is a hospitality group, and an Australian venue company, "The Booze Brothers," mentioned in search results.
